[SkinnyGoldfish] I don’t have this exact model but cuckoo is a great brand! I’ve been using mine for 3 years and it’s amazing!
[shutuptakemymoney101] I think it boils down to how you like your rice cooked, if you go Cuckoo it's the Korean way, if you go Tiger (another ubiquitous rice cooker brand) the rice is cooked to suit the Japanese ideal.
FWIW, I went from a Panasonic SR-DF81 rice cooker to a Tiger IH 10 cup JPW-G18A and I can't believe how much better the rice is in comparison.

[shutuptakemymoney101] No, was using the pot which came inside a Panasonic rice cooker for a number of years and none of the Teflon came off, the pot ended up concaving due to the heat so I swapped to a Tiger.
If you want the bowl to last longer hand wash it only and use a separate bowl when you're rinsing the rice.

The main difference that I can find is that the Cuckoo Micom has temperature adjustment so that it can better handle germinating rice and other oddities.
